title: DWARF — The Debugging Data Format
description: The file format that turns an address back into a source line. DWARF is how a debugger knows that 0x1154 is line 15, and it is the companion to the ELF, PE and Mach-O courses: those explain how a binary is loaded and run, this one explains how it is read. Built entirely from a single 18-line C file compiled with gcc -gdwarf-5 -O0, with every offset decoded by an independent parser and checked against readelf.
author: Underlayer
completion_criteria: Decode a .debug_line header and reproduce every row of a real line-number program, and explain how a debugger maps an address to a file and line.
